component.summary: Code editor with a local-first AI agent

description.p: PSCode is a fork of Visual Studio Code with an AI assistant built into the product rather than added as an extension: chat with workspace context, inline edit, and an agentic tool loop that reads and edits your files. It talks to a model running on your own machine, so no API key is required and no source code leaves the computer.
